verdict.line: You lose if you let mini Gnar poke freely with Boomerang Throw and reset range with Hop; you win if you catch him before his rage bar maxes and chain your Q shockwave into a W stun.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's 42.4% win rate over 271 games despite an EVEN lane shape comes from a tempo mismatch: Gnar's mini form pokes safely at 1100 range with Boomerang Throw and resets distance with Hop, while K'Sante has no ranged tool and must burn his short-cooldown Q/E just to close the gap. The solo-kill advantage still sits with K'Sante because once Gnar's E is down or his rage hasn't filled, K'Sante's Q 2-stack shockwave and W stun chain him down fast. But if the lane turns into a stalemate past level 6, Mega Gnar's AoE stun and eventual near-zero cooldown R flip the matchup toward him.

theirWindow.when: Gnar mini, Q and E both up
theirWindow.what: He can poke from 1100 range with Boomerang Throw, then Hop away or onto you to extend the trade. Hold minions between you and don't walk up to contest without your E (Footwork) shield ready.

yourWindow.what: Walk up and start stacking Q (Ntofo Strikes, 3.5s CD) — at 2 stacks the shockwave pulls him in, then W (Path Maker) charge-dash stuns him for the full combo. This is where K'Sante's solo-kill edge actually shows.

start.why: 45.7% win rate over 94 games. Its passive cuts damage from champion basic attacks and regens HP, which directly answers Gnar's Hyper-boosted autos and Boomerang chip better than raw HP from Helm.

boots.why: 84.6% pick rate and the correct call since every source of Gnar damage — Boomerang Throw, Hyper-empowered autos, Mega Gnar's melee hits — is physical.

core.why: Gives you the waveclear and attack-speed proc to punish Gnar when he's forced to walk up, and the slow helps you actually stick a Q/W chain on a champion built to disengage.

runes.keystoneWhy: Grants bonus resistances right after your CC lands, letting you survive the follow-up trade once your W (Path Maker) stun or Q shockwave pull connects. At master+ elo, 2,422 games show Grasp of the Undying preferred instead — better suited to players who win through sustained trading rather than committing to hard all-ins.

summoners.why: 43.6% win rate at 81.9% pick rate. Teleport lets you reset after losing extended poke exchanges and still arrive for objectives, which matters since this lane leans on scaling through a damage-losing laning phase rather than an early kill.

playing.title: Track Gnar's rage bar
playing.detail: Watch for near-max Rage signaling an incoming Mega transform. Time all-ins for well before it fills, while he's still squishy mini form.

playing.title: Punish a thrown Boomerang
playing.detail: Boomerang Throw has a 16-10s cooldown and only shortens if Gnar catches it on return. If he throws and can't recatch it, step up with E (Footwork) to start your trade.

playing.title: Bait out E before engaging
playing.detail: E (Hop/Crunch) is 22s at rank 1 and is his only disengage or range-extender. Once it's down, walk up safely and start stacking Q (Ntofo Strikes).

playing.title: Charge W into incoming poke
playing.detail: W (Path Maker) takes reduced damage while charging. Start the charge as his Boomerang or auto lands, then release the dash to knock him back and stun him.

playing.title: Hold R for the finish, not the open
playing.detail: R (All Out) only reaches 250 range. Use it to catch him through terrain after your Q shockwave or W stun has already landed, not as your first action.

playing.title: Respect Mega Gnar's stuns
playing.detail: Transformed, his W (Wallop) becomes an AoE stun and his R (GNAR!) stuns and deals bonus damage if you're thrown into a wall. Stay off walls once his rage is full.

playing.title: Lean on Steelcaps and Jak'Sho
playing.detail: Every point of Gnar's damage is physical, from Boomerang to Mega Gnar's melee. Plated Steelcaps and the Unending Despair into Jak'Sho path blunt both phases of his kit.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are my own tactical read, not measured data.
